_comment: Known failures of the synthetic products in the knx-sim flash-then-plan loop (test_sim_catalog_loop_synthetic_catalogue): application id to the step that fails first, with the open issue. A product here is the evidence of a bussard bug; the fix removes its entry. A listed product that fails at another step fails the test.

M-00FA_A-280F-11-0000.reason: syn-s7-lsm5: bussard sends the product's LdCtrlTaskSegment on LSM 5 (53 02 00 44 40 ...) to a 0701 device whose LSM 5 is Unloaded; ETS sends no LSM 5 record at all, and knx-sim leaves the machine Unloaded (#529), so the flash fails (#489)

M-00FA_A-278A-10-0000.reason: syn-master-reset-code4: the re-flash over the loaded device skips obj 4 (resident MCB match) but still sends the product's Master Reset erase code 4, which unloads it; the flash does not verify (#623)
